sentences.en: A runner must pass the baton in a relay race.
sentences.zh: 在接力赛中，运动员必须传递接力棒。

sentences.en: I need you to relay some information for me.
sentences.zh: 我需要你帮我转告一些信息。

sentences.en: I can only go by that which was relayed to me.
sentences.zh: 我只能依赖别人转述给我的信息。

senses.zh: [电工]继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马 -
